Our retailer's chatbot collects contact details and purchase histories to personalise offers. Assume the notification obligation applies and no exception removes it. The retailer has not told customers why it collects or uses this information. The supplier follows the Model AI Governance Framework and displays an AI label. Does this resolve the data issue?

Option A says yes, because the supplier follows a framework. That statement does not establish that the retailer has met its notification obligation. Option B says the retailer must address the applicable PDPA obligation before launch. This is the best answer. Option C says an AI label alone provides the required explanation.
